title: Hali ya Masharti (nge,ngali na ki) (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses -ki- for a real condition (ukisoma utapita), -nge- for an unlikely one now (ningekuwa na pesa ningenunua) and -ngali- for a past one that did not happen.
steps: Put the marker in both verbs as needed.
contexts: fighting terrorism: ukiona kitu cha kutiliwa shaka, ripoti

board.say: Ni sharti la kweli au la kufikirika?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Ukisoma" and one sentence with -nge-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani." Kwa nini "Ulisoma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sharti linaonyeshwa kwa -ki-, -sipo- au -nge-, si kwa -li-, -na- au -ta-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka." Kwa nini "wasipofanya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Soma sentensi nzima. Kama matokeo ni mazuri, sharti ni la kufanya (-ki-).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?" Kwa nini "-ta-" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ta- huonyesha wakati ujao. Ki- huonyesha sharti.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?" Kwa nini "-a-" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiambishi cha mtu (u-, a-, ni-) hakionyeshi sharti. Sharti ni -ki-, -sipo-, -nge-.
